offers_products.reason: Sells Arm & Hammer, OxiClean, Trojan, Vitafusion and other household and personal care brands, plus sodium bicarbonate.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from packaged consumer goods and specialty chemicals, not work done for customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Shoppers choose consumer brands like Arm & Hammer, Trojan, First Response and Waterpik sold through stores.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Retailers buy goods for resale; Specialty Products sells sodium bicarbonate and animal nutrition to industrial and agricultural businesses.

recurring_revenue.reason: Household staples such as laundry, baking soda, litter and personal care are bought repeatedly by the same shoppers and retailers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Everyday household and personal care essentials; demand holds in recessions, though some discretionary items may soften.

big_ticket.reason: Low-priced, frequently bought consumer items like detergent, toothbrushes, vitamins and baking soda.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured branded goods, not staff time or skill.

large_customers.reason: Households are the main end buyers, though big retailers carry the products; the company sells mostly consumer brands.

asset_heavy.reason: A brand-and-marketing consumer goods model that outsources some production; it does run its own plants.

notes: Large-customer and asset-heavy answers are judgment calls: sales go through large retailers, and the company runs its own plants.
